changelog: Recovery build for v1.3.20 after the header.php patch-count failure.
Core and Settings files are installed by full-file replacement instead of brittle text matching.
Settings is redesigned as a compact tap-to-open menu for Theme, Admin Account, System Update, Version History, App & Device and System Data.
Past Open Play schedules open full Session History with games, players, scores, winners, timestamps and duration.
Admin login is remembered securely on the same device for up to 30 days.
